personality_one_liner: A tactical, hardware-inspired command overlay featuring gunmetal gradients, glowing LED indicators, and industrial functional density.

spacing.rule: Dense and deliberate padding to simulate a hardware panel. Safe-area handled dynamically on the floating wrapper.

dont's: Do not use blur/glass on the SDR panel. It must feel like an opaque metal physical device blocking the UI beneath.

screens.name: Global Floating Command Toolbar
screens.purpose: A draggable, collapsible overlay providing immediate access to pentest/mesh operations.

states.collapsed: A draggable 56x56 circular 'bubble' showing the app enforcer mark (e.g., radar or crosshair). Snaps to left/right screen edges.
states.expanded: A rugged horizontal metal bar (approx 80-90px height) docked to the bottom or snapped to an edge.
states.error: LED strip on the offending button flashes #ff3860; haptic error feedback.

screens.layout: Use Reanimated and PanGestureHandler for the root wrapper. When collapsed: width=56, height=56, borderRadius=28. When expanded: width='90%', height=90, borderRadius=md. Layout structure inside expanded bar: `row` -> [Left spacer 60px for Phase 2 TX PWR Dial] | [ScrollView(horizontal) for 60x60 tactical buttons] | [Right spacer 60px for Phase 2 CH Dial]. Top-center absolute positioned container holds 3 pill toggles (MODE/SCAN/EXEC).

screens.name: Config Bottom Sheet
screens.purpose: Configure slots for the command toolbar.

states.empty: No assigned actions. Text: '// NO ACTIONS ASSIGNED' with a primary 'ADD' button.

screens.layout: Standard bottom sheet (dark theme: #0a1116) with a draggable handle. Internal layout is a Vertical ScrollView showing assigned tool slots as draggable list items. Each item lets the user pick Action Type, Icon, Label, and LED target color.

bubble_enforcer_mark.alt: Fallback abstract dark texture for the bubble, but prefer a vector icon (MaterialCommunityIcons 'radar' or 'shield-half-full')

instructions_to_main_agent: REANIMATED DRAG & SNAP: Wrap the entire toolbar in a PanGestureHandler from react-native-gesture-handler. Use `useAnimatedGestureHandler` to track x/y offsets. Use `withSpring` to snap to nearest screen edges (left or right, keeping within safe-area insets).

BUBBLE VS EXPANDED TRANSITION: Use `useAnimatedStyle`. Interpolate width (56 -> screenWidth - 32), height (56 -> 90), and borderRadius (28 -> 6) based on an `isExpanded` shared value boolean. The transition must feel mechanical and snappy.

GUNMETAL GRADIENT SPEC: The main expanded body uses `expo-linear-gradient`. colors={['#1c2833', '#0e1820', '#060a0f']} (top to bottom). Bevel edges using border layout: borderWidth: 1.5, borderTopColor: '#2b4052', borderBottomColor: '#000000', borderLeftColor: '#163041', borderRightColor: '#163041'.

CORNER SCREWS: Create an absolute-positioned 4px circle view in each corner of the expanded bar. Color: #04070a, border: #163041, with a tiny inner cross (or just a dark dot) to sell the industrial 'hex screw' hardware feel.

TACTICAL BUTTON CELL SPEC: Size 60x60, padding sm, center content. Background: #0a1116. Border: 1px #163041. Text: Monospace 10px #6c8a82 (engraved look). Icon: size 24. Press State: change background to #163041 or add inset shadow.

LED INDICATOR: Inside the button cell, place a View at the absolute bottom (or below the icon). height: 4, width: '60%', alignSelf: 'center', borderRadius: 2. Idle color: #163041. Firing color: #ffd400 with box-shadow (shadowColor: '#ffd400', shadowOpacity: 0.8, shadowRadius: 6). Success color: #00ff66. Error color: #ff3860.

PHASE 2 RESERVATION: In the flex-row that holds the expanded bar contents, place an empty `<View style={{ width: 60, justifyContent: 'center' }}>` on the far left, and one on the far right. Place the horizontal `<ScrollView>` of buttons between them. This leaves physical room for the future Knurled Dials.

PILL TOGGLES: Absolute position a small row at the top edge of the expanded bar (top: -12, alignSelf: 'center'). 3 tiny pills: MODE, SCAN, EXEC. Unselected bg: #0a1116, text #6c8a82. Selected bg: #163041, text #ffd400, border #ffd400.
HAPTICS: Must wire `Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Rigid)` on every button press, config gear tap, and bubble expand/collapse. The interface must feel heavy.
